# security-vault

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> HashiCorp Vault — centralized secret management
>
> DEPRECATED in favour of security/openbao (docs/apps/openbao.md). Vault 1.19 is
> BUSL-1.1, and this component ships file storage, plain-HTTP ingress, no audit device
> and no unseal story. OpenBao has the same API (MPL-2.0, Linux Foundation), raft
> storage, static-key unseal, snapshots, an External Secrets store and a tested
> bootstrap. Nothing in this repo consumes this component; whether it is removed is
> decided after the use-case builder integration (docs/openbao-plan.md).
>
> Deploys Vault in standalone mode with file storage backend.
> For production, tenants should patch to use raft or an external
> storage backend (consul, postgres, etc.).
>
> After deployment, Vault must be initialized and unsealed:
> kubectl exec -it vault-0 -n security -- vault operator init
> kubectl exec -it vault-0 -n security -- vault operator unseal <key>
>
> Tenant overlay can patch:
> - Storage backend (raft, consul, postgres)
> - Resource limits
> - Replicas (HA mode with raft)
> - Ingress hostname
> - TLS configuration

**Source:** [`k8s/components/apps/security/vault/`](../../k8s/components/apps/security/vault/)

## Notes

**Deprecated** in favour of [security-openbao](security-openbao.md), per the
component's header: Vault 1.19 is BUSL-1.1, and this component ships file
storage, a plain-HTTP ingress, no audit device and no unseal story. Nothing in
the repo consumes it. Removal is decided after the use-case builder integration
([`docs/openbao-plan.md`](../../docs/openbao-plan.md), open points).
